niche_preference_profile: This user most consistently prefers interfaces that feel clean, clearly structured, and easy to scan, with strong hierarchy, grouped modular cards, and enough spacing to avoid crowding. They often favor simplified presentation over overloaded layouts, but still want visible utility and complete information when it is well organized. Visually, they lean toward softer, more polished treatments: rounded cards and buttons, subtle rather than flashy accents, restrained decorative effects, and refined card surfaces. They frequently prefer light or airy presentations for readability, though in some contexts they also like dark premium surfaces when contrast and focus are strong. They respond well to clear labels, obvious calls to action, visible sectioning, and layouts that foreground the primary content or task without unnecessary visual noise.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers layouts that are not crowded: fewer items visible at once, more whitespace, clearer separation, and easier scanning instead of dense, tightly packed content.
Prefers strong visual hierarchy with one obvious focal point, prominent titles or key data, and supporting details arranged in a clearly prioritized order.
Prefers content organized into distinct cards, grouped sections, and modular blocks rather than continuous canvases, floating elements, or monolithic panels.
Prefers rounded cards, buttons, chips, and controls with softer edges over sharper rectangles; usually favors rounded rectangles or pills when they feel polished and cohesive.
Prefers calm, understated, polished interfaces with subtle effects and limited visual noise rather than flashy, glowing, gamified, or overly decorative styling.
Prefers readable text presentation with visible labels, clear section headings, descriptive copy, and stronger contrast that makes content easier to understand quickly.
Prefers obvious, well-emphasized actions and usable controls: visible primary buttons, explicit action rows, integrated control groupings, and interfaces that make next steps clear.
